patong.name: Patong Beach
patong.intro: Spend a relaxed day between the sea, restaurants and shops at Patong. A curved sandy bay runs along Phuket’s west coast, with hotels and a busy neighbourhood just behind it. It suits friends or couples who want a beach walk followed by a meal. Leave the day free of hurried sightseeing and enjoy moving between the waterfront and town.
experienceTitles: A beach walk, a meal and some shopping
Take your time beside the sea
experience: Walk around Patong’s curved sandy bay with your partner or friends, then head out for a meal. Hotels, restaurants and shops cluster behind the sand, so you can enjoy the sea, eat and shop without travelling far.

Patong suits people who enjoy a lively beach beside a busy neighbourhood. Walk on the sand, have a meal and return to the waterfront. If you swim, use only the areas permitted locally, away from boats and water sports equipment. Follow flags and lifeguards even when the water looks calm.
patong.access: On the west coast of Phuket’s main island, Patong is accessible by road. You do not need a boat to another island.
patong.swimming: Swim away from boats and water sports equipment. Before entering the sea, follow the beach flags and lifeguards’ instructions.
patong.facilities: Hotels, restaurants and shops sit behind the beach. Take a break on the sand, then head out for food or shopping.
patong.transport: Search for ‘Patong Beach’ when arranging a car. The beach is long, so also tell the driver your hotel or the restaurant where you are meeting. Use the directions link to find the destination and see where it lies in relation to your accommodation.
faq: Who would enjoy Patong?

Friends and couples can combine a seaside walk with eating and shopping. Hotels, restaurants and shops are close behind the beach, so you can stay nearby after a walk. Visit on a day when you do not have to rush off to another attraction.
Do I need a boat to reach Patong Beach?

No. Patong is on the west coast of Phuket’s main island and can be reached by car. You do not need to book an island boat tour. Give the driver ‘Patong Beach’ and your hotel or meeting restaurant’s name.

karon.name: Karon Beach
karon.intro: For a slow walk on a long stretch of white sand, head to Karon on Phuket’s west coast, north of Kata. The open sea and long shoreline make it a pleasant place to walk and talk with your partner or family. Afterwards, take your time over a meal at a nearby restaurant.
experienceTitles: A leisurely walk along white sand
Stay close to your accommodation
experience: Walk slowly along Karon’s long white beach and look out over the open sea. It suits couples and families who want time to talk as they walk. You can spend the day strolling and eating nearby rather than packing in many attractions.

Restaurants, shops and accommodation surround Karon. Walk on the stretch near your hotel, then head out for a meal. Because the beach is long, a search for Karon Beach may take you far from your accommodation. Give your driver the hotel or restaurant name too.
karon.access: Karon lies west of Phuket and north of Kata, with road access. The long sandy beach is Karon Yai. Karon Noi to the north is a hotel-guest access area with different entry conditions.
karon.swimming: When waves are high, enjoy a walk on the sand instead of swimming. Sea conditions change from day to day, even along this open coastline.
karon.facilities: Restaurants, shops and accommodation are nearby. After walking on the sand, stop for a meal and a rest.
karon.transport: Search for ‘Karon Beach’. Both ends use the same name, so tell your driver your hotel or restaurant too. If you also want to visit Kata to the south, finish your Karon walk and travel separately to Kata Beach.
faq: Are Karon and Kata the same beach?
No. Karon is a separate beach north of Kata. Search for Karon Beach to reach its long sandy shore. Search separately for Kata Beach if you plan to visit both.
Can anyone enter Karon Noi?
Karon Noi to the north is a hotel-guest access area. Its conditions differ from the long sands of Karon Yai. Ask the relevant hotel about entry before visiting Karon Noi.
What can I do at Karon?
Walk along the sand, rest with a sea view and eat at a nearby restaurant. It suits a day combining a stroll and a meal. If waves are high or swimming is prohibited, keep your plans to the shore.

kata.name: Kata Beach
kata.intro: Enjoy a curved bay and sandy shore at Kata on Phuket’s west coast. This is Kata Yai, south of Karon, with hotels, restaurants, bars and souvenir shops nearby. Come with friends or your partner for a relaxed day moving between the beach and a meal, and take a slow walk around the bay.
experienceTitles: Time beside a curved bay
A relaxed day between beach and restaurants
experience: Kata is a compact bay south of Karon. Walk along the sand with friends or your partner and enjoy the curve of the coast and the sea. It suits a slow day near your accommodation, with time for a sea view and a meal.

Hotels, restaurants, bars and souvenir shops surround Kata Yai. Rest at the beach, go out for food and browse nearby shops. Kata Noi to the south is a separate beach, so make clear whether you mean Kata Beach or Kata Noi Beach when meeting friends or arranging a car.
kata.access: Kata Yai is on Phuket’s main island’s west coast and has road access. Kata Noi to the south is a separate beach.
kata.swimming: Keep away from surfing and water sports areas when swimming. Follow the day’s flags and local instructions about where entering the sea is permitted.
kata.facilities: Hotels, restaurants, bars and souvenir shops surround Kata Yai. You can take a beach break, eat and browse the shops nearby.
kata.transport: Search for ‘Kata Beach’ to find Kata Yai. It is separate from Kata Noi to the south, so check your accommodation name as well. The directions link helps you find the route between your hotel and the sand. Any route through hotel grounds is subject to that hotel’s access rules.
faq: Are Kata and Kata Noi the same place?
No. Kata Beach, also called Kata Yai, and Kata Noi are separate. Kata Noi lies south of Kata Yai. Give your accommodation address and specify Kata Beach or Kata Noi Beach when arranging a car.
Can I visit Kata as well as Karon?
Yes. Kata is south of Karon, so you can visit both. They are not one continuous sandy beach; allow time to travel between them. Search separately for Karon Beach and Kata Beach.

pattaya.name: Pattaya Beach
pattaya.intro: Step out to Pattaya Beach in front of Beach Road when you want a sea view during a day in town. Sand follows the curved bay, with hotels, restaurants and shopping nearby. Walk with friends after exploring the city, or bring the family before or after a meal and take a break beside the sea.
experienceTitles: The waterfront and town along Beach Road
Choose the northern or central and southern stretch
experience: Along Beach Road, you can combine Pattaya’s waterfront with time in town. Hotels, restaurants and shopping are close, making it easy to step onto the sand after a meal or shopping. Stop for a sea-view break with friends or family.

Try the northern stretch for a quieter walk. The central and southern areas suit a meal followed by shopping. Events and the time of your visit can change the atmosphere. Swim only in locally permitted areas, clear of boats and water sports equipment.
pattaya.access: The beach is accessible by road in front of Pattaya’s Beach Road. It is separate from Jomtien to the south and from the beach with the same name on Ko Lipe.
pattaya.swimming: Do not swim where boats and water sports equipment operate. Use only the swimming areas permitted locally.
pattaya.facilities: Hotels, restaurants and shopping cluster around Beach Road. Before using beach chairs or rental services, ask about charges and conditions.
pattaya.transport: Search for ‘Pattaya Beach, Chon Buri’. As the beach runs a long way along Beach Road, also give the driver your hotel or meeting building’s name. Decide whether you want a northern walk or food and shopping around the central and southern areas, then choose a nearby drop-off.
faq: Are Pattaya Beach and Jomtien the same place?

No. Pattaya Beach is in front of Beach Road in town; Jomtien is a separate beach to the south. Search for Jomtien Beach to visit it. For a sea view alongside central Pattaya’s restaurants and shops, head to the Beach Road shore.
Where can I take a quieter walk?
Try the northern part of Pattaya Beach. It is relatively quieter than the central and southern stretches, although events and the time of your visit can change the atmosphere.

jomtien.name: Jomtien Beach
jomtien.intro: Head south of central Pattaya for a leisurely walk along Jomtien’s long coast. Accommodation and restaurants line the seaside road, making it easy to rest by the beach and go out for a meal. Come with family or your partner when you want time on a different shore from the city centre. Start with the sand nearest your accommodation.
experienceTitles: Walk along the long coastline
A different shore south of central Pattaya
experience: Enjoy the sea as you walk along Jomtien’s long sandy shore. Start near your accommodation and eat at a restaurant by the coast road afterwards. For a relaxed day with friends or family, leave plenty of time at the beach instead of scheduling many other stops.

Jomtien is the long coastline south of Pattaya Beach. Restaurants and accommodation by the seaside road make it easy to eat after a walk. Atmosphere and nearby facilities vary along its length. Where water sports operate, keep clear of boats and equipment when swimming.
jomtien.access: Jomtien is a separate beach south of Pattaya with road access. Jomtien Bus Terminal and the beach are different places.
jomtien.swimming: Keep away from water sports equipment and use only locally permitted swimming areas. On arrival, look at the day’s flags and instructions before entering the water.
jomtien.facilities: Accommodation and restaurants line the seaside road. Walk near your hotel and head out for a meal. Nearby restaurants and facilities vary along this long beach.
jomtien.transport: Search for ‘Jomtien Beach’. Make sure your destination is on the coast rather than at Jomtien Bus Terminal, and give your driver your hotel or meeting restaurant’s name. If also visiting Pattaya’s Beach Road, allow time to travel between the two beaches.
faq: Who would enjoy Jomtien?

It suits travellers who want to relax on a different coastline after exploring central Pattaya. Walk on the long sandy beach and eat near the seaside road. Staying nearby makes a walk and a meal possible without going far. Atmosphere and facilities differ along the shore.
Is Jomtien Bus Terminal right on the beach?
The terminal and beach are different places. Search for Jomtien Beach and specify your hotel or meeting restaurant. You still need to travel to the beach after arriving at the bus terminal.

chaweng.name: Chaweng Beach
chaweng.intro: For a long curve of white sand on Ko Samui, visit Chaweng on the island’s east coast. Stay nearby and spend time resting beside the sea. Take a walk with your partner or family and pause when a view catches your eye. On a day without plans elsewhere, settle into an unhurried day at the beach.
experienceTitles: White sand around a curved coastline
Ask about the route from your hotel
experience: Walk along Chaweng’s long white beach and enjoy the curved coastline. Pause to admire a view with your partner or family. Spend some days near your accommodation and explore another stretch of beach on others.

The route from accommodation to the sand varies along this long beach. Ask how to reach it when booking. A hotel at Chaweng Noi to the south puts you on a different beach. Even near your own hotel, stay clear of water sports areas when swimming.
chaweng.access: After arriving on Ko Samui, travel to Chaweng by the island’s roads. Chaweng Noi to the south is a separate beach.
chaweng.swimming: Swim only in locally permitted areas, away from water sports equipment. Follow the beach flags and lifeguards’ instructions.
chaweng.facilities: Accommodation is well established along Chaweng. Ask your hotel about its route to the sand before a walk or swim. Use hotel facilities according to your booking conditions.
chaweng.transport: On the island, search for ‘Chaweng Beach’ and specify your accommodation or meeting point along the long shore. If your hotel is at Chaweng Noi to the south, search using the hotel name.
faq: Are Chaweng and Chaweng Noi the same beach?

No. Chaweng Noi is a separate beach south of Chaweng. Use your hotel name and address to see which beach you are staying on. Give the hotel name when arranging a car to avoid reaching the wrong beach.
How do I get to Chaweng?
After arriving on Ko Samui, use the island’s roads. Specify Chaweng Beach together with your accommodation or meeting place. As the shore is long, an exact place name makes meeting on arrival easier.

lamai.name: Lamai Beach
lamai.intro: Relax beside a palm-lined curve of sand at Lamai on Ko Samui’s east coast, south of Chaweng. Accommodation and restaurants are nearby. It suits a leisurely day walking and eating with your partner or family. Even if you do not swim, take time to enjoy the palms and sea.
experienceTitles: Walk along the palm-lined shore
Make time for walking as well as swimming
experience: Enjoy Lamai’s curved sand and palm-lined coast. Walk with your partner or family, then have a meal nearby. If you want to see both Chaweng and Lamai, look up the road journey between them when arranging accommodation.

Some parts of Lamai have deep water and potentially strong waves. With children, leave plenty of time for a walk on the sand and a meal nearby. If swimming is permitted locally, keep children from going far out.
lamai.access: Lamai is on Ko Samui’s east coast, south of Chaweng, and is accessible by the island’s roads.
lamai.swimming: Some sections can have deep water and strong waves. Keep children from going far out, even where the water appears shallow. Follow local instructions about permitted swimming areas.
lamai.facilities: Restaurants and accommodation are nearby, making it possible to walk, eat and spend a relaxed day beside the beach.
lamai.transport: Search for ‘Lamai Beach’ and give your driver your hotel or meeting restaurant’s name. Travel by the island’s roads if you also want to see Chaweng. The two are not connected by one continuous sandy beach, so leave time for the journey.
faq: Is Lamai suitable for swimming with children?

Some parts have deep water and potentially strong waves, so take particular care. Keep children from going far out even where it appears shallow. Use only areas permitted on the day, and allow time for a family beach walk or a meal as well.
Can I walk continuously along the beach from Chaweng to Lamai?
No. Lamai is a separate beach south of Chaweng. Travel between them using the island’s roads; they are not one continuous stretch of sand.

maya-bay.name: Maya Bay
maya-bay.intro: Visit Maya Bay on Phi Phi Leh for white sand enclosed by tall limestone cliffs. Walk beside the bay and take in the sea and rock scenery with friends or your partner. Plan a boat visit to a national park shore where you enjoy the scenery without swimming.
experienceTitles: White sand enclosed by limestone cliffs
Enjoy the national park shore without swimming
experience: Limestone cliffs rise on both sides of Maya Bay, framing its white sand. Walk with friends or your partner and look out over the enclosed bay. Set aside a boat trip to Phi Phi Leh separately from days spent near your accommodation on Phi Phi Don.

Maya Bay is a national park beach with seasonal closures and controlled entry for natural recovery. It reopened on 1 October 2026, but swimming remains prohibited in designated park areas. After landing, walk only within the area park staff permit and enjoy the sand, cliffs and bay.
maya-bay.access: Maya Bay is on Phi Phi Leh and requires a boat. It has seasonal closures and controlled access for natural recovery, and reopened on 1 October 2026. Ask whether landing at Maya Bay is allowed on your visit date when booking.
maya-bay.swimming: Plan to enjoy the beach without swimming. Swimming is prohibited in designated national park areas. Walk only within the area indicated by park staff.
maya-bay.facilities: Entry is managed by the national park. Ask whether your boat trip permits landing and walking on the beach, and whether park admission is included. A trip that only views the bay from offshore offers something different.
maya-bay.transport: When booking, ask ‘Can we land at Maya Bay and walk on the beach?’ Some trips only view it from offshore. Before paying, ask what the boat fare and park admission include and what happens if bad weather cancels the trip.
faq: Can I swim at Maya Bay?

Visit for a walk and the scenery without swimming. Swimming is prohibited in designated national park areas. Even after reopening, keep to the area park staff permit when walking on the sand and enjoying the bay.
Can I walk there from Phi Phi Don?
No. Maya Bay is on Phi Phi Leh, so you need a boat from Phi Phi Don. It is not reachable within the same island like Loh Dalum. Ask whether your boat trip allows landing and walking on the beach.

loh-dalum.name: Loh Dalum Beach
loh-dalum.intro: If you are staying on Phi Phi Don, take a break beside Loh Dalum’s north-facing bay. It offers a different shore from Tonsai. Come with friends or your partner for a beach walk during a stay on the island. On days without a boat trip elsewhere, relax with a view of the bay.
experienceTitles: A beach day while staying on Phi Phi Don
From Tonsai Pier to your accommodation
experience: Loh Dalum suits a day when you want to leave your accommodation and relax by the sea on Phi Phi Don. Walk on the sand or rest facing the northern bay. After a trip to Maya Bay on Phi Phi Leh, take a day here without hurrying for another boat.

Phi Phi Don has two bays, Tonsai and Loh Dalum. After arriving at Tonsai Pier, continue to your accommodation or the beach at Loh Dalum. If carrying luggage, have your hotel name and address ready and look up the route from the pier in advance.
loh-dalum.access: Take a boat to Phi Phi Don, then continue across the island to Loh Dalum. Tonsai Pier and Loh Dalum are in different bays.
loh-dalum.swimming: Look at the flags and local entry instructions before swimming. Watch the water depth, avoid going far out and keep clear of moving boats.
loh-dalum.facilities: Phi Phi Don has accommodation. If spending time at Loh Dalum, look up both the route from your arrival pier to your hotel and the way from the hotel to the beach.
loh-dalum.transport: Book a boat to Phi Phi Don, then continue from the arrival pier to your Loh Dalum accommodation or the beach. Tonsai Pier is in a different bay. With luggage, prepare your hotel name and address and look up the route beforehand.
faq: Are Loh Dalum and Maya Bay on the same island?
No. Loh Dalum is on Phi Phi Don and Maya Bay is on Phi Phi Leh. If staying on Phi Phi Don, travel within the island to Loh Dalum. Set aside a separate boat trip for Maya Bay.
Is Tonsai Pier at Loh Dalum Beach?

No. Tonsai and Loh Dalum are different bays on Phi Phi Don. Continue from Tonsai Pier to your hotel or the beach at Loh Dalum. If carrying luggage, mark your accommodation on the map and look up the way from the pier first.

ao-nang.name: Ao Nang Beach
ao-nang.intro: Head to Ao Nang for a Krabi stay combining the sea, meals and boat trips. Limestone cliffs are visible from the shore, with restaurants, hotels and shops nearby. With friends or family, plan a beach walk one day and a trip to Railay or nearby islands another. Take time on the sand before or after your boat journey.
experienceTitles: A seaside walk beneath limestone scenery
Boat trips to Railay and nearby islands
experience: Walk on Ao Nang’s sand with views of limestone cliffs beside the sea. After a stroll with friends or family, eat at a nearby restaurant and browse the shops. A beach break also suits the end of a boat trip.

Long-tail boats connect Ao Nang with Railay. Ask which beach you will arrive at and where to board the return boat. Snorkelling trips to nearby islands and swimming at Ao Nang Beach take place in different locations. At the beach, avoid boat areas and use only locally permitted swimming zones.
ao-nang.access: Ao Nang is on mainland Krabi and can be reached by road. Boats leave the shore for Railay and nearby islands. Separate entry conditions apply at each destination.
ao-nang.swimming: Do not swim where boats arrive and depart. Offshore island snorkelling trips from Ao Nang take place elsewhere. At Ao Nang Beach, swim only where it is permitted locally.
ao-nang.facilities: Restaurants, hotels and shops cluster around the beach. You can eat or buy what you need before a boat trip.
ao-nang.transport: Travel to Ao Nang Beach by road. For Railay, take a long-tail boat after arriving at Ao Nang. Arrange the boarding point and return journey before leaving. Waves and weather can delay or cancel boats, so leave flexibility in your return plans.
faq: Can I get to Railay from Ao Nang?
Yes. Long-tail boats travel from Ao Nang to Railay. Ask which Railay beach you will land at. Before departing, agree on the return boat arrangements and meeting point.
Can I snorkel straight from Ao Nang Beach?

Nearby-island snorkelling trips by boat and swimming at Ao Nang Beach take place in different locations. Boats come and go at Ao Nang, so do not swim in their operating areas. Use only areas permitted locally on the day.

railay-west.name: Railay West Beach
railay-west.intro: Relax on white sand between limestone cliffs at Railay West, on the west side of the Railay peninsula. Come by boat with your partner or friends for time beside the sea and cliffs. If your return boat is arranged, stay to enjoy the western sea at sunset.
experienceTitles: White sand and limestone cliffs
Arrange your return before staying for sunset
experience: At Railay West, limestone cliffs rise beside a white sandy shore. Take a walk, then rest with your companions and look out over the sea. Its west-facing position also suits a visit for the evening view.

If you want white sand, ask whether your boat lands at Railay West. Railay East has a muddy shore and rock-climbing activities, with different scenery. Before leaving Ao Nang for a sunset visit, agree on the return boat conditions and meeting place. If staying overnight, ask how to reach your hotel from the landing point.
railay-west.access: Take a boat from Ao Nang to Railay. Although Railay is a peninsula, you cannot drive straight from Ao Nang to this beach.
railay-west.swimming: West has a sandy beach, while East has a muddy shoreline. Even at West, keep clear of boats and follow the day’s flags and local swimming instructions.
railay-west.facilities: Railay has accommodation. The route after disembarking depends on whether your hotel is on the east or west side.
railay-west.transport: When boarding at Ao Nang, ask ‘Does this boat land at Railay West?’ Give your hotel name if staying. If you want to return after sunset, arrange the return boat conditions and meeting place before leaving.
faq: How do Railay East and West differ?

West offers white sand and a view of the western sea; East has a muddy shoreline and rock-climbing activities. Choose West for sand and sunset scenery. If staying on the east side, ask about the route from the landing point to your accommodation.
Can I drive directly from Ao Nang?

No. Take a boat from Ao Nang. Being on a peninsula does not mean there is a direct road to the beach from Ao Nang. Ask whether you will land at Railay West and agree on the return boat conditions and meeting place.

nang-thong.name: Nang Thong Beach
nang-thong.intro: Discover fine black sand and the large Nang Thong rock rising from the sea at this Khao Lak beach. It lies by Ban Bang La On in Khuk Khak, Phangnga. Walk with friends or family and enjoy a different scene from an all-white sandy beach, with time to look at the sand, rock and sea.
experienceTitles: Black sand and Nang Thong rock
Approaching the rock at low tide
experience: Look for fine black sand mixed into the beach and the large Nang Thong rock offshore. Walk with friends or family and enjoy the sand, rock and sea together. It suits a day when you want a different Khao Lak shore from white sand alone.

Ground near Nang Thong rock can emerge at low tide. How close you may go depends on the tide, waves and local restrictions. Ask locally before approaching and remain within permitted areas. This is not a path you can always walk; when access is not possible, enjoy the black sand and rock from the beach.
nang-thong.access: Accessible by road, Nang Thong is on the coast of Ban Bang La On in Khuk Khak, Phangnga. It is in a different area from Phuket’s beaches.
nang-thong.swimming: Waves and rip currents can lead to swimming prohibitions. Being able to walk on the beach does not mean entering the sea is allowed. Follow the day’s flags and local restrictions.
nang-thong.facilities: Access roads lead from Phet Kasem Road towards the shore. Ask how to reach the sand from your accommodation before heading out for a walk.
nang-thong.transport: Search for ‘Nang Thong Beach’ in Khao Lak and take the access road from Phet Kasem Road towards the sea. If starting at your accommodation, ask staff for the route to the sand. Any route through another resort is subject to that resort’s entry rules.
faq: What is there to see at Nang Thong?

Look for fine black sand and the large Nang Thong rock offshore. Ground near it may emerge at low tide, but it is not always a walkable route. Follow the day’s tide, waves and local instructions before approaching.
Is Nang Thong in Phuket?
No. It is on the Phangnga coast in the Khao Lak area, by Ban Bang La On in Khuk Khak. Search for Nang Thong Beach together with your hotel to find the right location.
Does the pin mark a beach entrance?

No. It represents the beach area, not a car park or hotel entrance. Choose your hotel or an actual shore access route as your destination. Follow resort entry conditions for any route through its grounds.

bang-niang.name: Bang Niang Beach
bang-niang.intro: For a slow walk and a wide Andaman Sea view in Khao Lak, head to Bang Niang’s long sandy coast. It lies by Ban Bang Niang in Khuk Khak, Phangnga, reached by turning from the main road towards the sea. Stay nearby with your partner or family and enjoy an unhurried day without rushing elsewhere.
experienceTitles: A break beside the long Andaman shoreline
The route from the main road to the beach
experience: Walk slowly along Bang Niang’s long sandy shore and look out over the Andaman Sea. It suits a day of rest with your partner or family. If staying nearby, enjoy an easy walk on a day without travelling far.

Reach Bang Niang by turning towards the sea from Phet Kasem Road. Ask your hotel staff about the way to the sand and back. A route through a resort is subject to its access rules. Give your accommodation name as the drop-off point to begin your walk nearby.
bang-niang.access: Bang Niang lies on the coast of Ban Bang Niang in Khuk Khak, Phangnga. Turn from Phet Kasem Road towards the sea.
bang-niang.swimming: Watch for high waves and rip currents on this Andaman coast. Do not swim when red flags are flying or local staff prohibit entering the water.
bang-niang.facilities: Accommodation is available around the shore. Ask about the beach access route and available facilities when booking, and how to return after your beach break.
bang-niang.transport: Search for ‘Bang Niang Beach’ and turn towards the coast from Phet Kasem Road. If staying nearby, use your accommodation as the arrival point and ask for the way to the beach. Follow the access rules if crossing another resort.
faq: Where is Bang Niang Beach?

It is beside Ban Bang Niang in Khuk Khak, Phangnga, in the Khao Lak travel area. Turn from Phet Kasem Road towards the sea. It is separate from Phuket, so search for Bang Niang Beach with your hotel name.
Can I reach the beach through a beachfront resort?

Each resort has its own access conditions. If staying there, ask staff for the route. Visitors from elsewhere need to use an available shore access route; a particular resort is not the beach’s only entrance.

hua-hin.name: Hua Hin Beach
hua-hin.intro: Add a seaside walk to a day in Hua Hin, a town known as a royal retreat. Sand runs beside the town, making it a pleasant stop with parents or children before or after a meal. If staying near the beach, come out for a relaxed break on days without plans farther away.
experienceTitles: A seaside walk during a day in town
Horse riding and the coast farther south
experience: Combine time in Hua Hin town with a walk on the sand. After a meal with parents or children, step out to the sea and pause for a rest. Staying near the beach makes a walk easy even on days without a longer outing.

Horse riding is one activity on Hua Hin Beach. Before using it, ask whether it is operating that day, the price and how it works. Watch for passing horses when walking too. Allow time to travel south to Khao Takiab if you also want hill-and-sea scenery.
hua-hin.access: The beach lies beside Hua Hin town in Prachuap Khiri Khan and is accessible by road.
hua-hin.swimming: Follow the day’s flags and local swimming instructions. When walking on the sand, also watch for areas used by horses.
hua-hin.facilities: If you want to ride a horse on the beach, ask whether rides are operating that day, then ask about the price and arrangements before using the service.
hua-hin.transport: Search for ‘Hua Hin Beach’ and specify your hotel or meeting building. To visit Khao Takiab to the south as well, search for it separately and travel there.
faq: Can I ride a horse at Hua Hin Beach?
Yes, horse riding is available at Hua Hin Beach. Ask about operation on your visit day, the price and arrangements before using it. Even when walking without riding, watch for passing horses.
Can I visit Khao Takiab as well?

Yes. You can also explore the beach and hill at Khao Takiab, south of Hua Hin. Look up the route from your hotel or your starting point on Hua Hin Beach to Khao Takiab Beach. If visiting the hilltop temple, allow separate time for the beach and the journey up to the temple.

khao-takiab.name: Khao Takiab Beach
khao-takiab.intro: Head south of Hua Hin for a beach beside Khao Takiab hill and its temple. Walk with family or your partner and enjoy the sand, sea and hillside together. Take time to rest on the shore, then leave room in your day to visit the temple above.
experienceTitles: A hill-and-sea view from the sand
Allow time for the hilltop temple
experience: Walk beside the sea with your family or partner and look up at the hill rising next to the sand. The scenery differs from central Hua Hin. The mapped beach is north of the hill, with a different route from the southern shore. Tell your driver which side you want.

There is a temple on Khao Takiab hill. If you want to visit after resting on the beach, look up the route using the temple name. You still need to travel uphill after reaching the sand, so allow separate, unhurried time for both.
khao-takiab.access: The beach surrounds Khao Takiab hill south of Hua Hin. The northern sandy shore and hilltop temple are separate destinations.
khao-takiab.swimming: There are rocky areas around the hill. Watch your footing and the waves near rocks. Follow the day’s flags and local instructions for entering the water.
khao-takiab.facilities: A temple stands on Khao Takiab hill beside the beach. If visiting it after a beach break, leave separate time to reach the temple.
khao-takiab.transport: Search for ‘Khao Takiab Beach’ and select the route to the sand north of the hill. It differs from the route to the southern coast. For a temple visit, set a new destination using the temple name rather than the beach.
faq: Does the Khao Takiab beach pin mark the temple entrance?
No. It marks the sandy area north of Khao Takiab hill. The temple is uphill, so search separately using the temple name. The route also differs from the way to the southern shore.
How does it differ from Hua Hin Beach?

Farther south than central Hua Hin, this coast combines a hill and temple with the sea. Enjoy a walk looking at both the water and hillside. If also visiting the temple, allow time to travel from the beach up the hill.

white-sand.name: White Sand Beach
white-sand.intro: For a Ko Chang beach with restaurants and shops nearby, try White Sand Beach, called Hat Sai Khao in Thai. Accommodation and shops cluster around the white sand on the island’s northwest coast. Friends and families can relax by the sea, step out for a meal and spend a slow day between beach and village.
experienceTitles: A beach break followed by a meal
Watch the water depth with children
experience: White Sand suits travellers looking for beachside accommodation and nearby conveniences. Walk on the sand, have a meal and come back to the sea. Hotels, restaurants, shops and convenience stores let you spend time exploring both shore and village.

The water depth is uneven along this coast. Keep children from going far out, even where it looks shallow, and swim only where it is permitted on the day. On days without swimming, enjoy a beach walk and a meal nearby.
white-sand.access: After arriving on Ko Chang, follow the roads towards the northwest coast. The Thai name is Hat Sai Khao.
white-sand.swimming: Depths are uneven along the shore. Do not go far out even where it appears shallow. Take particular care with children and use only locally permitted areas.
white-sand.facilities: Accommodation, restaurants, shops and convenience stores cluster around the beach. You can rest on the sand, eat nearby or buy what you need.
white-sand.transport: On Ko Chang, search for ‘White Sand Beach’ or ‘Hat Sai Khao, Ko Chang’. It lies along the northwest coast beyond Klong Son. The pin marks Hat Sai Khao village, so give your driver your hotel or meeting restaurant. Find the actual beach entrance or parking separately.
faq: Are White Sand Beach and Hat Sai Khao the same place?
Yes. White Sand Beach on Ko Chang is called Hat Sai Khao in Thai. It lies on the northwest coast beyond Klong Son. Include Ko Chang when searching for accommodation or directions.
Can children play safely in shallow water here?

Depths are uneven, so take care even where it looks shallow. Keep children from going far out and use only areas permitted locally that day. A beach walk and a nearby meal are alternatives on days without swimming.

klong-prao.name: Klong Prao Beach
klong-prao.intro: Walk beside palms on Klong Prao’s broad sandy coast, south of White Sand on Ko Chang’s west side. It suits couples or families staying nearby who want a day with time for a sea view and a relaxed walk together. Leave room simply to rest beside the water.
experienceTitles: A broad sandy coast lined with palms
Do not swim at Laem Chai Chet’s rocky cape
experience: Walk along Klong Prao’s broad, palm-lined sand with your partner or family, then continue to a nearby restaurant for a meal. Some accommodation is set back from the main road, so you may need to continue after your drop-off. With luggage, ask the hotel how far a vehicle can enter and how to cover the remaining route.

Laem Chai Chet at the northern end is a rocky cape unsuitable for swimming. Do not swim there. On Klong Prao’s sandy shore too, pay attention to water depth and follow the day’s flags and local instructions.
klong-prao.access: Klong Prao is on Ko Chang’s west coast, south of White Sand. Continue from the island road along the route to your accommodation or the shore.
klong-prao.swimming: Do not swim at the rocky cape of Laem Chai Chet to the north. On the sandy beach, watch the depth and follow the day’s flags and local swimming instructions.
klong-prao.facilities: Accommodation, restaurants and bars are nearby. Some hotels are set back from the main road, so there may be a further journey after getting out of your vehicle.
klong-prao.transport: Search for ‘Klong Prao Beach, Ko Chang’ and specify your accommodation as the arrival point. If dropped on the main road, you may still need to reach the hotel or sand. With luggage, ask your hotel where to get out.
faq: Can I swim at Laem Chai Chet?
The northern rocky cape of Laem Chai Chet is unsuitable for swimming. Do not swim there. Even on Klong Prao’s sandy shore, follow the day’s flags and local instructions.
Am I at the beach as soon as I leave the road?

You may need to continue, depending on your accommodation and shore access route. Some hotels are set back from the road. With luggage, ask whether your vehicle reaches the hotel; if it stops at the main road, ask the hotel about the remaining route.

sai-kaew.name: Sai Kaew Beach
sai-kaew.intro: Visit Sai Kaew on Ko Samet for white sand and meals near the sea. Take a boat from Ban Phe on the mainland to this island off Rayong. It suits friends or couples staying near the shore who want a leisurely day of sea views, meals and rest.
experienceTitles: A day beside white sand
From the arrival pier to your beach
experience: Walk on Sai Kaew’s white sand and relax with a sea view. Ko Samet has accommodation, restaurants, bars and convenience stores, letting you combine meals and rest near the beach. Come with friends or your partner for an unhurried stay of a few days.

When booking a boat from Ban Phe, ask which Ko Samet pier it uses. Arriving at Na Dan means continuing across the island to your hotel and Sai Kaew Beach. Ask what transfers are included. Park entry conditions are separate from the boat fare, so ask whether admission is included and what other entry requirements apply.
sai-kaew.access: Take a boat from mainland Ban Phe to Ko Samet, then continue from your arrival pier, such as Na Dan, to the beach. Consider national park entry conditions separately from the boat fare.
sai-kaew.swimming: Before entering the sea, look at the flags, the permitted area and the day’s waves. Follow local instructions. Do not enter when a flag or instruction prohibits it, even if the sea appears calm.
sai-kaew.facilities: Ko Samet has accommodation, restaurants, bars and convenience stores. Stay near the beach to combine meals and a rest by the sea.
sai-kaew.transport: Take a boat from Ban Phe to Ko Samet and continue from the arrival pier to Sai Kaew. Ask whether you arrive at Na Dan or another pier and give your hotel location to arrange the onward route. Boat times and prices can vary with weather and operating conditions.
faq: Is this Sai Kaew Beach in Sattahip?
No. This Sai Kaew is on Ko Samet off Rayong. Sattahip has another beach of the same name. Include Ko Samet when searching for Sai Kaew Beach directions or accommodation.
Does the boat from Ban Phe land directly on the beach?

You may need to continue from the arrival pier. If arriving at Na Dan, travel from there to your hotel and Sai Kaew. Ask the boat operator about the arrival point and included transfers, and review national park entry conditions as well.

wong-duean.name: Ao Wong Duean
wong-duean.intro: Relax beside the crescent-shaped bay of Ao Wong Duean on Ko Samet, where white sand curves around the sea. It suits couples or families who want to step out from their accommodation for a walk and spend time in one place. Take a slow stroll around the bay and enjoy the curved shoreline.
experienceTitles: A walk around a crescent-shaped bay
From Ban Phe to Ao Wong Duean
experience: Ao Wong Duean’s white sandy shore curves around the bay like a crescent. Walk with friends or your partner and look out at the coastline and sea. Leave plenty of time here on a day when you want to step out from your hotel and rest by the water.

Take a boat from Ban Phe to Ao Wong Duean, or arrive at Na Dan Pier and continue across the island. When booking, ask ‘Do we arrive at Ao Wong Duean or Na Dan?’ Give your hotel name too. If carrying luggage, ask about the route from the landing point to the hotel in advance.
wong-duean.access: Ao Wong Duean is a bay on Ko Samet, reached after taking a boat to the island.
wong-duean.swimming: Avoid areas used by boats. Even in this curved bay, waves change daily, so follow the day’s flags and local swimming instructions.
wong-duean.facilities: White sand curves around the crescent-shaped bay. Spend a relaxed day walking out from your accommodation and resting with a view of the water.
wong-duean.transport: When booking from Ban Phe, ask for a service to ‘Wong Duean’ or ‘Wong Duen’. A boat arriving at Na Dan Pier requires an onward journey across the island. Know both your landing point and your accommodation’s location.
faq: Are Ao Wong Duean and Wong Duen the same place?
Yes. The crescent-shaped bay and beach on Ko Samet are called Ao Wong Duean, also written Wong Duen in English. Include Ko Samet when searching for hotels or boats.
What should I ask when booking a boat?
Ask whether you arrive at Ao Wong Duean or Na Dan Pier. From Na Dan, you need to continue across the island. Give your hotel name and ask how to reach it from the landing point.
